skill.descTemplate:
冷却时间减少，【成长】2次后的效果提升。
召唤旋转的舞者刀刃，每次命中时，造成64%冷凝伤害，旋转结束时，会造成一次587%的冷凝伤害。命中目标后10秒内，附近队伍的角色每次施放共鸣技能或共鸣解放时，会对怪物附加3层【无寐】且累积施放6次/15次共鸣技能或共鸣解放后，自身声骸将获得【成长】，在当前关卡中将提升攻击范围和伤害，最多可获【成长】2次。
【成长】1次后，会使舞者刀刃，每次命中时，造成80%冷凝伤害，旋转结束时，会造成一次734%的冷凝伤害。
【成长】2次后，会使舞者刀刃，每次命中时，造成160%冷凝伤害，旋转结束时，会造成一次1467%的冷凝伤害。
【无寐】：怪物身上的【无寐】达到100层时，【无寐坠星】将从天而降，造成湮灭伤害并使怪物瘫痪。
声骸技能冷却：24秒

skill.descEnRank5:
Skill CD is reduced. Gaining Progression 2 times now offers a stronger bonus.
Summon spinning dancer blades that deal 64% Glacio DMG per hit. When the spinning ends, deals 587% Glacio DMG once. Within 10s after hitting a target, each time a nearby Resonator in the team casts a Resonance Skill or Resonance Liberation, the target gains 3 stacks of Sleepless. When the team cumulatively casts Resonance Skills or Resonance Liberations 6 times, and again at 15 times, the Echo gains Progression, increasing its attack range and DMG for the current stage. Progression can be gained up to 2 times.
After gaining Progression 1 time, the dancer blades deal 80% Glacio DMG per hit, and deal 734% Glacio DMG at the end of the spinning.
After gaining Progression 2 times, the dancer blades deal 160% Glacio DMG per hit, and deal 1467% Glacio DMG at the end of the spinning.
Sleepless: When Sleepless on the target reaches 100 stacks, Wakening Starfall is summoned from the sky, dealing Havoc DMG and Immobilizing the target.
Echo Skill Cooldown: 24s
skill.simple:
召唤【教律龙爪】，对周围敌人造成气动伤害。
在首位装配时，提高自身气动和重击伤害。
